description: This file exports types, constants, and functions related to the channel API in the openclaw plugin SDK, mainly re-exporting from other modules for use elsewhere in the project.

methods.name: buildProbeChannelStatusSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary of the channel status for probing purposes, imported from status-helpers.
